newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares down on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares down on higher turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares were down on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as A shares fell to $110.125 from Friday's $111.875 and B shares also slightly fell to $115 from $115.875.
Turnover was 6,862 shares from 4,745 on Friday and value was $764,860.25 from $537,439.
Also traded on the BSE were 11,000 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.1875 slightly down from $1.21875 on December 5 when 500 shares changed hands.
There was no trade in the shares of the three other listed companies -- Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.70 percent to 81.88 and the BLOM stock index also fell 1.35 percent to 945.75.
